name: legal-compass
description: Legal intelligence tool for Brazilian and international legislation. Searches federal laws, regulatory norms, administrative acts and court precedents. Covers LGPD compliance, labor law, tax regulation and constitutional provisions.

tools.name: search_legislation
tools.description: Searches Brazilian federal legislation by keyword, law number or subject. Returns law text, publication date, scope and current status (active, revoked, amended).

tools.name: check_compliance
tools.description: Evaluates whether a described business practice or data processing activity complies with LGPD, GDPR or sector-specific regulations. Returns compliance status and required corrective actions.

tools.name: get_court_precedents
tools.description: Retrieves relevant court decisions and precedents from STF, STJ and TRFs for a given legal topic or case description.
